purpose: Refine ERA38 scope after Red Team and repository alignment audit: no product-specific patch, no new engine, no root bloat, no runtime mutation.

selected_next_work_unit.scope_rule: Generic first, News as first consumer. No News-only product code.

reuse_existing_systems.use: Reuse fast/heavy path, bounded review, priority classes and overflow policy.
Reuse RAW/STAGING/VALIDATED/CANONICAL/QUARANTINE/EVIDENCE_SIDECAR thinking, source reliability and lineage.
Reuse opportunity-cost-of-silence and context-only recheck discipline.
Reuse unknown anomaly boundary; adversarial fixtures validate the boundary rather than duplicate engine logic.

minimal_delta_rules.staging_compact_rule: Staging/context item carries correlation_id only, not heavy provenance metadata.
minimal_delta_rules.provenance_sidecar_rule: Detailed provenance lives in a sidecar/map keyed by correlation_id.
minimal_delta_rules.atomic_write_rule: correlation_id sidecar/map write must be confirmed before an item becomes READY_FOR_FAST_PATH.
minimal_delta_rules.ttl_archive_rule: Active registry keeps only active/pending provenance. Completed, expired or canonicalized details move to archive/evidence sidecar lifecycle.
minimal_delta_rules.fast_path_rule: Fast Path reads compact ready state only and never waits for Heavy Path analysis.
minimal_delta_rules.heavy_path_rule: Heavy Path may read sidecar details by correlation_id within budget and TTL constraints.

success_criteria: ERA38 validates existing architecture reuse rather than adding a new engine.
No staging bloat: provenance details stay out of staging payloads.
Atomic correlation write prevents sidecar race condition.
Fast Path is never blocked by Heavy Path or News validation.
News-specific cases validate generic harness without creating News-only code.
